title: Import And Export Executive
description:
Job Title: Import & Export Documentation Executive 
 Department: Import & Export Documentaiton / Logistics
 Experience: 15 Years
 Location: Pune
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Import & Export Documentation Executive to manage import and export documentation, coordinate with customers, suppliers, freight forwarders, customs agents, and logistics partners, and ensure shipments are processed accurately and on time. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Prepare, verify, and maintain import and export documentation. Prepare documents such as Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Purchase Orders, Shipping Bills, Bills of Lading/Airway Bills, Certificates of Origin, and other shipping documents . Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, transporters, and other logistics partners. Ensure all documentation is accurate and submitted within required timelines. Coordinate with internal teams such as Sales, Purchase, Accounts, Warehouse, and Logistics. Track import and export shipments and provide regular status updates. Follow up on shipment bookings, dispatches, customs clearance, and delivery. Check documentation against purchase orders, invoices, and shipment details. Maintain proper records of import/export transactions and supporting documents. Assist with customs clearance documentation and resolve documentation-related issues. Ensure compliance with applicable import/export procedures and company policies. Coordinate with banks and other parties for documentation related to export payments or trade transactions, where applicable. Monitor shipment schedules and proactively communicate delays or discrepancies. Maintain accurate databases, trackers, and documentation files. Support audits by providing required import/export records and documents. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Logistics, Supply Chain, International Business, or a related field . 14 years of experience in Import/Export Documentation, Logistics, Shipping, or International Trade . Good knowledge of import/export documentation and shipping procedures. Familiarity with customs clearance processes and freight forwarding. Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, and email communication . Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines simultaneously. Good follow-up and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills 
 Knowledge of Incoterms and international shipping procedures. Familiarity with HS Codes, customs documentation, and export/import compliance . Experience working with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and shipping lines. Knowledge of ERP systems or logistics software. Experience with both air and sea shipments will be an advantage. Key Competencies 
 Attention to Detail Documentation Management Coordination & Follow-up Time Management Communication Skills Problem Solving Compliance Awareness Teamwork 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Accuracy and completeness of import/export documentation. Timely submission of shipping and customs documents. On-time shipment processing and coordination. Reduction in documentation errors and delays. Effective coordination with logistics and business partners. Proper maintenance of shipment records and documentation.

Key Skills: Export Import Documentation,EXIM,Export Import,Documentation,Import documentation,Import Export,Export,Import

description:
Job Title : Senior Database Engineer 
 Location : Pune 
 Experience : 7- 12 years 
 Work Mode : Hybrid (3 Days WFO) 
 Must Have"s : 
 - Cloud Database 
 - AWS, Postgres, Snowflake, Oracle RDS 
 - Medallion Architecture 
 - DBT 
 - AI/ML Solutions 
 - Python 
 - Database design 
 Role Overview : 
 Join our DevOps Engineering team as a Senior Database Engineer responsible for designing, optimizing, and automating cloud database solutions across AWS RDS, Postgres, and Snowflake. This role focuses on performance engineering, data integration, and automation - ensuring our data platforms are scalable, reliable, and efficient. Youll work closely with DevOps and Product Engineering to build high-performing data infrastructure that supports critical applications and analytics. 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 Modern Data Architecture & Platform Engineering : 
 - Architect and optimize scalable data platforms using Snowflake, PostgreSQL, and Oracle RDS. 
 - Design cloud-native lakehouse architectures on AWS using Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns. 
 - Build hybrid systems spanning operational databases and analytical warehouses. 
 - Develop performant data models, ELT pipelines, semantic layers, and reusable metrics. 
 - Manage schema evolution, replication, partitioning, and lifecycle strategies for scalability and resilience. 
 Advanced Data Pipelines & Orchestration : 
 - Engineer reliable batch and nearreal-time ELT pipelines using dbt and cloud-native services. 
 - Implement data quality, schema validation, lineage, and observability. 
 - Optimize performance, scalability, and cost across data workflows. 
 AI-Enabled Data Engineering : 
 - Apply AI/ML for anomaly detection, schema drift detection, and query optimization. 
 - Design AI-ready data foundations supporting feature stores and ML pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with Data Science teams to ensure reproducible, governed ML workflows. 
 Automation, DevOps & Governance : 
 - Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform with CI/CD-enabled data deployments. 
 - Automate provisioning and monitoring using Python, SQL, and APIs. 
 - Implement enterprise-grade security, governance, RBAC, encryption, and compliance controls. 
 Required Skills & Experience : 
 - 7+ years of experience in data engineering, database engineering, or data platform development in production environments. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, including performance tuning, security, and cost optimization. 
 - Deep expertise with PostgreSQL and AWS RDS in cloud-native architectures. 
 - Proven experience designing lakehouse or modern data warehouse architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture, semantic layers, and analytics engineering best practices. 
 - Experience building and operating advanced ELT pipelines using modern tooling (e.g., dbt, orchestration frameworks). 
 - Proficiency with SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and tooling. 
 - Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code for data platforms. 
 - Solid understanding of data governance, observability, and reliability engineering

title: Dot Net Technical Lead
description:
.NET Technical Lead Application Modernization & Azure Migration Experience 
 Mode: Work from Office. 
 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced .NET Technical Lead to lead the modernization and cloud transformation of an existing enterprise application. The candidate will be responsible for driving technical solutions across .NET Framework migration, Azure cloud migration, API refactoring, containerization, database optimization, UI modernization, batch-to-event-driven transformation, and production rollout support . The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on technical expertise along with the ability to lead developers, collaborate with architects and business stakeholders, and drive modernization initiatives from assessment through production implementation. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 
 Mandatory 
 Strong experience in C# and .NET / .NET Framework . Hands-on experience with ASP.NET Core / Web API . Strong understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture . Experience migrating .NET Framework applications to modern .NET . Strong experience with Microsoft Azure . Hands-on experience with Docker and containerization . Strong SQL/database development and performance optimization experience. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Azure DevOps . Strong understanding of application security, authentication, and authorization. Experience with production deployment and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of software design principles and architecture patterns. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with AKS / Kubernetes . Experience with Azure Service Bus / Event Grid / Event Hubs . Experience with Kafka . Experience with Angular / React . Experience with Azure Functions . Experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform/Bicep . Experience with Application Insights and Azure Monitor . Experience with legacy application modernization and technical debt reduction. Experience with performance engineering and load testing. 
 
 Architecture & Design Responsibilities 
 The Technical Lead will be expected to: Analyze the existing application architecture and identify modernization opportunities. Define target-state architecture for cloud migration. Create technical design documents and architecture diagrams. Evaluate build vs. refactor vs. re-engineer options. Define integration and event-driven architecture patterns. Establish coding, API, logging, exception-handling, and deployment standards. Conduct technical design and code reviews. Identify technical risks and provide mitigation strategies. 
 
 Leadership Responsibilities 
 Lead a team of .NET developers and provide technical direction. Break down requirements into technical tasks and assign work to team members. Mentor developers and promote engineering best practices. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards. Work closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA, DevOps, DBA, and infrastructure teams. Track technical progress, dependencies, risks, and blockers. Provide technical estimates and contribute to project planning. Communicate technical challenges and progress effectively to stakeholders. 
 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred: Large-scale legacy application modernization . .NET Framework modern .NET migration. On-premises Azure migration. Monolith modular/microservices architecture. Batch processing event-driven architecture . API modernization and performance optimization. Containerization and Kubernetes. Enterprise application production migration and stabilization. 
 
 Key Competencies 
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent understanding of application architecture and design patterns. Strong technical leadership and decision-making abilities. Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical priorities. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to balance modernization objectives with business continuity and production stability. Strong ownership and delivery mindset. 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor s / Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 
 Role Success Criteria 
 Success in this role will be measured by the candidate's ability to: Successfully modernize legacy .NET applications. Drive the Azure migration with minimal business disruption. Improve API and application performance. Successfully containerize and deploy applications. Improve database performance and data quality. Transform suitable batch processes into scalable event-driven workflows. Ensure stable and controlled production rollouts. Provide strong technical leadership and mentoring to the development team.
